items.question: How do I reset my password?
items.answer: Use “Forgot password” on the sign-in page. The reset link is valid for one hour.

items.question: Can I change my plan later?
items.answer: Yes — upgrades apply immediately, downgrades at the next billing cycle.

items.question: Do you offer refunds?
items.answer: Full refund within 30 days, no questions asked.
